header.author: Luan Felipe
header.title: Mandacaru the Cactus
header.info: Mandacaru is a cactus of the Brazilian sertão with a leather hat.[br]He plays forró on his sanfona, dances xote, celebrates the rain when his white flowers bloom,[br]waves to the asa-branca and greets the jegue, the calango and the galo-de-campina.
